_provenance.note: Vendored MCP inputSchema for every AES tool the gateway calls. Extracted directly from AES's own tool-definition source via tsx, not hand-copied. Refresh after any AES schema change and re-run tests/unit/outbound_gateway/test_cliq_contract.py.

_runtime_rules.note: Rules AES enforces in code or by documented design, not in inputSchema. Source: Agent-Email-Server/src/tools/cliq-bot-tools.ts (parseCliqChannelBotPost/parseCliqChatPost) and cliq-chat-id.ts (CLIQ_CHAT_ID_PATTERN + its 2026-09-03 incident comment).

cliq_channel_bot_post.channel_unique_nam.reason: Explicit for a CT_* value (cliq-bot-tools.ts parseCliqChannelBotPost: channelUniqueName.startsWith('CT_') throws). A >=15-digit numeric value has no matching local throw, but cliq-chat-id.ts's own rationale for MIN_CLIQ_NUMERIC_CHAT_ID_DIGITS establishes that space as chat ids, not channel unique names, and its 2026-09-03 incident shows Zoho rejects it with an opaque operation_failed 400 rather than a clear channel-not-found error -- exactly the kind of failure this contract test exists to catch before it reaches Zoho.

channel_unique_name.description: Zoho Cliq channel unique name, for example 'acquisition'. Do not pass '#Acquisition' or a CT_* chat id.

text.description: Plain text message to post as the bot. Maximum 5000 characters.

bot_unique_name.description: Zoho Cliq bot unique name. Defaults to 'nigelgeneral' for @Nigel-General.

idempotency_key.description: Stable outbound intent key. Identical destination/content reuses original result for 24 hours.

allow_repeat.description: Explicit intentional repeat: bypass the 2-minute content guard. A repeated idempotency_key still suppresses.

sync_message.description: Request a synchronous Zoho response containing message_id when supported. Defaults to true.

reply_to.description: Optional Zoho message ID to reply to in the channel.

chat_id.description: Zoho existing DM/group chat ID. Do not pass a channel unique name or a user id (ZUID). Expected a numeric Cliq chat id of at least 15 digits (e.g. 1424728044450751028) or a CT_<chat>_<user> conversation id (e.g. CT_2198174035284346737_721156495).
